selection.rule: Never-reviewed first; otherwise oldest lastProvenanceReview, Record ID tie-breaker

instanceResults.finding: Kaplan et al. power-law scaling of held-out cross-entropy loss, not direct novel-task generalisation. Existing record caveat accurate.
Brown et al. GPT-3 175B, few-shot task evaluations without parameter updates; training-set novelty not demonstrated, as already qualified.

Wei et al. TMLR survey documents emergent threshold patterns in arithmetic, unscrambling and augmented chain-of-thought prompting; claims are framed as reported apparent emergence and contested by IN-004.
Schaeffer et al. metric-choice account and bounded task/model-family conclusions accurately represented; not universal dismissal of scaling.
Golchin and Surdeanu report GPT-4 contamination findings for AG News, WNLI, XSum; record correctly declines to infer contamination-driven gains for MMLU, HellaSwag or ARC.
Hoffmann et al. compute-optimal parameter/token scaling and 70B Chinchilla downstream comparisons supported; novelty caveat maintained.
Snell et al. >4x test-time compute efficiency and FLOPs-matched 14x-larger-model conditional comparison supported; inference axis kept distinct from claim's training axis.
